intl.title: Ball State - Steps to Admission (International Admissions and Services: first-time undergraduate dates, criteria, English)

eng.title: Ball State - English Proficiency Requirements & Conditional Admission Information

test_policy.notes: International first-time undergraduate page: SAT/ACT are not required for admission, but scores may be used to meet the English proficiency requirement (SAT EBRW 500 or ACT English 21).

requirements.notes: International applicants apply through the Ball State international admissions portal and pay $60; no individual fee waivers. Needs secondary school transcripts and English proficiency proof; some majors require a design portfolio, audition or essay. The page says no GPA guarantees admission, but the CDS shows 95% of international first-year applicants admitted in Fall 2025.

deadlines.label: Priority date (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: CDS C14 lists March 1 as the priority date without a year; treated as 2027. Ball State admits on a rolling basis.

deadlines.label: International application materials due (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Page says 'Fall Term - application materials due by June 15th' without a year; treated as 2027. Spring term: November 15.

deadlines.label: #YouAreWelcomeHere Scholarship application (essay or video)
deadlines.notes: Two annual $14,000 awards for incoming first-year international students; the page gives March 31 without a year (treated as 2027). The Global scholarships need no separate application per the page.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required for all applicants with an education history outside the U.S. unless waived. Waived with a U.S. high school diploma, U.S. college degree or 24 credit hours at an accredited U.S. university, or the same from a listed English-speaking country (e.g. UK, Ireland, Canada excluding Quebec, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, Nigeria, Ghana, Philippines), or at the discretion of International Admissions for English-medium study. Scores valid 24 months. SAT EBRW 500 or ACT English 21 also satisfies the requirement.

english.notes: MyBest scores accepted. Academic Bridge Program (part-time Intensive English Institute plus degree classes) at 75-78. Conditional admission to the Intensive English Institute from 42; the degree requirement must then be met before starting degree classes. The page does not give the new 1-6 TOEFL scale.
IELTS Academic. Bridge Program at 6.0; Intensive English Institute conditional admission from 4.5.
Bridge Program at 100-105; Intensive English Institute conditional admission from 65.
Bridge Program at 51-52; Intensive English Institute conditional admission from 40.

aid.notes: Admission-based international scholarships pay part of nonresident tuition, per year for up to 8 semesters, for full-time on-campus degree students (not usable for Intensive English Institute study): Global Achievement $12,000, Global Distinction $14,000, Global Presidential $16,000 (awarded from Spring 2025 onward; the page does not publish the criteria for each level). Recipients must meet the English requirement first.

toefl.note: Ball State school code 1051 as printed on the English proficiency page; scores must be sent electronically.

sat.note: The same page prints school code 1051 for test reports; confirm in the College Board code search if the portal does not accept it.

act.note: No ACT code is printed on the Ball State pages read; look it up at act.org.

ielts.note: Send electronically to Ball State University Admissions (admissions@bsu.edu); no numeric code listed.

duolingo.note: No institution code is listed on the page.
